svg.title: Pro Exteriors — Official Roofing Partner of Texas Motor Speedway
svg.desc: Section graphic announcing Pro Exteriors as the official roofing partner of Texas Motor Speedway. Deep navy background with diagonal stripe pattern. A photograph of the Pro Exteriors crew gathered in a job-site huddle occupies the right portion, with deep-navy gradient blend toning it into the brand palette. Headline and flag-red call-to-action sit on the left.

g.text: Trusted by the Track. Built for Texas.
The same crews trusted at one of America's most iconic motorsports
venues protect warehouses, churches, and family homes across Texas.
One standard of work — from the grandstand at TMS to your street.
